assessment: Gold bottom, slowing hikes, tax-revenue weakness and Bitcoin's three-year direction were supported. Value and megacap calls face strong contrary return evidence, though their timing was vague. FTX fraud and unbacked liabilities were accurately diagnosed, while US regulation was overstated as protection from customer-fund misuse. Brazil's transfer succeeded amid serious violence; the local rate peak and earnings/dividend observations were useful, while its decade investment case remains open.
